parts:
Hi,
Just copying the example apps on the shiny home page 
http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/
and trying out in R Studio, I get the following error

Error in do.call(serverFunc, args) : 
  'what' must be a character string or a function

Any suggessions?
Thanks

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Error in do.call(serverFunc, args) : 'what' must be a character string or a function
parts:
Are you sure that your code starts with this?
  shinyServer(function(input, output) { ... }

It sounds like your passing shinyServer() something other than a function.

-Winston
